name: ShopEase-Store
description: ShopEase is a feature-rich e-commerce website built with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and Firebase. It provides a smooth and responsive shopping experience with real-time database integration for secure user authentication and data management.

paragraphs: Welcome to ShopEase, a powerful and user-friendly e-commerce platform designed for seamless shopping. Built using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and Firebase, ShopEase provides a smooth, responsive, and secure experience for users.
✅ Modern & Responsive Design – Works flawlessly on all devices.
✅ Dark Mode Support – Enhanced accessibility for a better browsing experience..
